jobs.title: Industrial Controlling Manager
jobs.description:
Descrizione della posizione

La posizione è inserita all'interno della funzione Finance & Administration e, all’interno del team di Controlling & Planning, avrà il ruolo di coordinare le attività di Industrial Controlling all’interno del gruppo IBSA, garantendo una uniformità di procedure di pianificazione e reporting. Si occuperà inoltre di supportare l’organizzazione delle Technical Operations nella realizzazione dei programmi di efficientamento industriale.

Responsabilità

- Coordinamento dei processi di pianificazione e reporting industriali

- Sviluppo e mantenimento della reportistica industriale di gruppo

- Armonizzazione delle procedure di contabilità industriale e costi a livello di gruppo

- Coordinamento del piano industriale a 5 anni e del piano investimenti

- Elaborazione di business case industriali

- Analisi di Make vs Buy e supporto alle TechOps nell’ottimizzazione del manufacturing footprint del gruppo

- Supportare l’analisi della spesa industriale (incl. acquisti diretti e indiretti)

- Indicare misure di cost saving in ambito industriale e supportarne l’esecuzione

Competenze tecniche richieste

- Ottima conoscenza delle metodologie di analisi dei costi industriali e delle principali metodologie di product costing

- Esperienza nella gestione di team (con o senza riporto gerarchico)

- Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di programmi di efficientamento industriale

- Conoscenza dei principi di “Lean Manufacturing”

- Livello avanzato nell'utilizzo del pacchetto Office, in particolare di Excel

- Buona conoscenza dei vari moduli del gestionale SAP (CO-FI, SD, PP, MM, ...);

- Conoscenza dei principi di contabilità

- Spiccate doti analitiche

Profilo richiesto

- Master in Economia Aziendale o Ingegneria;

- Minimo 10 anni di esperienza nel ruolo, in contesti industriali multinazionali (preferibilmente nel settore farmaceutico) o in società di consulenza;

- Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata;

- Sono richieste: spirito di iniziativa, attitudine al lavoro in team, buona capacità organizzativa del lavoro personale e forti doti analitiche;

- Capacità di gestire il proprio carico di lavoro per garantire il rispetto di tutte le scadenze.

Luogo di lavoro

IBSA Institut Biochimique SA, Pambio-Noranco, Svizzera
requirements: Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata;

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location description

The position is inserted within the Finance & Administration function and, within the Controlling & Planning team, will be the role of coordinating the activities of Industrial Controlling within the IBSA group, ensuring a uniformity of planning and reporting procedures. It will also support the organization of Technical Operations in the implementation of industrial efficiency programs.

Liability

- Coordination of industrial planning and reporting processes

- Development and maintenance of industrial group reporting

- Harmonization of industrial accounting procedures and group-level costs

- Coordination of the 5 year industrial plan and investment plan

- Business case processing

- Analysis of Make vs Buy and TechOps support in Group Manufacturing Optimization

- Support industrial spending analysis (incl. direct and indirect purchases)

- Indicate cost saving measures in industry and support its execution

Technical skills required

- Excellent knowledge of industrial cost analysis methods and the main product cost methodologies

- Experience in team management (with or without hierarchical carryover)

- Experience in managing industrial efficiency programs

- Knowledge of the principles of “Lean Manufacturing”

- Advanced level in using the Office package, especially Excel

- Good knowledge of the various modules of the SAP management (CO-FI, SD, PP, MM, ...);

- Knowledge of accounting principles

- Explains analytical qualities

Profile requested

- Master in Business Economics or Engineering;

- Minimum 10 years of experience in the role, in multinational industrial contexts (preferably in the pharmaceutical sector) or in consulting companies;

- Good knowledge of English, written and spoken;

- They are required: spirit of initiative, attitude to teamwork, good organizational ability of personal work and strong analytical skills;

- Ability to manage your workload to ensure compliance with all deadlines.

Place of work

IBSA Institut Biochimique SA, Pambio-Noranco, Switzerland

Standortbeschreibung

Die Position wird innerhalb der Finanz- und Verwaltungsfunktion eingefügt und innerhalb des Controlling & Planning-Teams wird die Rolle der Koordination der Aktivitäten des Industrial Controlling innerhalb der IBSA-Gruppe sein, um eine Einheitlichkeit der Planungs- und Berichtsverfahren zu gewährleisten. Es wird auch die Organisation von Technical Operations bei der Umsetzung von industriellen Effizienzprogrammen unterstützen.

Haftung

- Koordination industrieller Planungs- und Reportingprozesse

- Entwicklung und Pflege der Berichterstattung über Industriegruppen

- Harmonisierung industrieller Buchhaltungsverfahren und Kosten auf Gruppenebene

- Koordinierung des fünfjährigen Industrie- und Investitionsplans

- Business Case Verarbeitung

- Analyse der Unterstützung von Make vs. Buy und TechOps in der Optimierung der Gruppenfertigung

- Unterstützung der Analyse der industriellen Ausgaben (einschließlich direkter und indirekter Käufe)

- Kosteneinsparungsmaßnahmen in der Industrie angeben und deren Umsetzung unterstützen

Erforderliche technische Fähigkeiten

- Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der industriellen Kostenanalysemethoden und der wichtigsten Produktkostenmethoden

- Erfahrung im Teammanagement (mit oder ohne hierarchische Übertragung)

- Erfahrung im Management von industriellen Effizienzprogrammen

- Kenntnis der Prinzipien von „Lean Manufacturing

- Erweiterte Ebene bei der Verwendung des Office-Pakets, insbesondere Excel

- Gute Kenntnisse der verschiedenen Module des SAP-Managements (CO-FI, SD, PP, MM, ...);

- Kenntnis der Rechnungslegungsgrundsätze

- Erklärt analytische Qualitäten

Profil angefordert

- Master in Betriebswirtschaft oder Engineering;

- Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der Rolle, in multinationalen industriellen Kontexten (vorzugsweise im Pharmasektor) oder in Beratungsunternehmen;

- Gute Englischkenntnisse, geschrieben und gesprochen;

- Sie sind erforderlich: Initiativgeist, Einstellung zur Teamarbeit, gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten der persönlichen Arbeit und starke analytische Fähigkeiten;

- Fähigkeit, Ihre Arbeitsbelastung zu verwalten, um die Einhaltung aller Fristen sicherzustellen.

Arbeitsort

IBSA Institut Biochimique SA, Pambio-Noranco, Schweiz

- Analyse du support Make vs Buy et TechOps dans l'optimisation de la fabrication en groupe

- Soutenir l'analyse des dépenses industrielles (y compris les achats directs et indirects)

- Indiquer les mesures d'économie dans l'industrie et soutenir son exécution

Compétences techniques requises

- Excellente connaissance des méthodes d'analyse des coûts industriels et des principales méthodologies de coût des produits

- Expérience en gestion d'équipe (avec ou sans report hiérarchique)

- Expérience dans la gestion des programmes d'efficacité industrielle

- Connaissance des principes de l'industrie manufacturière

- Niveau avancé dans l'utilisation du paquet Office, en particulier Excel

- Bonne connaissance des différents modules de la gestion SAP (CO-FI, SD, PP, MM, ...);

- Connaissance des principes comptables

- Explique les qualités analytiques

Profil demandé

- Maîtrise en économie des affaires ou en génie;

- Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le rôle, dans les contextes industriels multinationaux (de préférence dans le secteur pharmaceutique) ou dans les sociétés de conseil;

- Bonne connaissance de l'anglais, écrite et parlée;

- Ils sont nécessaires : esprit d'initiative, attitude à l'égard du travail d'équipe, bonne capacité d'organisation du travail personnel et compétences analytiques solides;

- Capacité de gérer votre charge de travail pour assurer le respect de toutes les échéances.

Lieu de travail

jobs.title: IT Category Manager
jobs.description:
The IT Category Manager is responsible for the end-to-end procurement strategy and operational management of all Information Technology spend at IBSA, including software, hardware and IT consultancy services.

A core principle of this role is the adoption of a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) approach to all sourcing decisions, prioritising long-term value and holistic risk management

The Category Manager must be able to articulate and share this perspective to internal stakeholders and ensure it is embedded in all category strategies and supplier evaluations.

The position acts as the strategic interface between the Procurement function and the Enterprise Technology & Transformation (ET&T) function, ensuring that IT sourcing decisions deliver value for money, minimise risk, and align with IBSA's digital transformation agenda. Category strategy is defined in close collaboration with ET&T leadership, ensuring full alignment between technology direction and procurement execution.

Key Responsibilities

Category Strategy

- Develop and implement a comprehensive IT category strategy covering software (licences, SaaS, ERP), hardware (infrastructure, devices, network) and IT consulting and managed services — defined in concert with the Enterprise Technology & Transformation (ET&T) function to ensure full alignment with the technology roadmap.

- Conduct regular market analysis to identify sourcing opportunities, emerging vendors and technology trends relevant to IBSA's business.

- Define and maintain a supplier segmentation model and category roadmap aligned with business priorities.

- Embed a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) methodology in all category decisions, ensuring that short-term price savings are never pursued at the expense of long-term value, service continuity or operational risk.

- Maintain an IT supply risk register, proactively identifying and mitigating concentration risk, vendor dependency, cybersecurity exposure, and contract lock-in.

Sourcing & Contracting

- Lead competitive tender processes (RFI, RFQ, RFP) for IT categories in full compliance with IBSA procurement policy.

- Negotiate contracts, SLAs, pricing structures and commercial terms with IT vendors, ensuring best Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) — with explicit consideration of implementation, integration, maintenance, training and exit costs, not only licence or purchase price.

- Manage contract lifecycle including renewals, amendments and exit strategies.

- Work closely with Legal to ensure contractual protection on data security, IP, liability and GDPR compliance.

Supplier Relationship Management

- Build and maintain strategic relationships with key IT suppliers, conducting regular business reviews and performance evaluations.

- Monitor supplier performance against agreed KPIs and SLAs; escalate issues and drive corrective action plans where necessary.

- Identify and develop alternative sources to reduce supply risk.

Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary procurement business partner for the ET&T function and other internal stakeholders with IT spend.

- Collaborate with ET&T leadership to understand demand forecasts, project pipelines and technology roadmaps.

Financial, Compliance & Governance Management

- Deliver measurable added value within the IT category on an annual basis.

- Manage category spend transparency, providing accurate and timely reporting on committed and forecast expenditure.

- Support the annual budget process by providing market intelligence and benchmark data to IT stakeholders.

- Ensure all IT procurement activities comply with IBSA internal policies, procedures and applicable regulations.

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Master's degree or equivalent in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or related field

- Minimum 10 years of experience in procurement, with at least 5 years in IT category management in a multinational environment.

- Demonstrated track record of managing complex IT contracts (software licensing, cloud services, hardware, consulting).

- Strong negotiation skills with experience in large-scale vendor negotiations.

- Solid understanding of IT market dynamics, licensing models (perpetual, subscription, SaaS) and managed service structures.

- Experience with P2P platforms and e-procurement tools; familiarity with Jaggaer is a plus.

- Fluent in English and Italian; French or German is an advantage.

Key Competencies

- Strategic thinking: ability to develop category strategies that align with business objectives and deliver long-term value.

- Commercial acumen: strong analytical skills and financial literacy; ability to model TCO across the full asset lifecycle and evaluate complex commercial proposals beyond headline price.

- Risk management: proactive identification and mitigation of supply, contractual, cybersecurity and operational risk in the IT category; ability to balance risk appetite with commercial opportunity.

- Influencing skills: Effective at building relationships and influencing without formal authority across functions and seniority levels.

- Results orientation: proactive, ownership mindset with a track record of delivering against targets in complex environments.

- Integrity & compliance: uncompromising ethical standards; ensures all procurement activity is conducted with full transparency.

Technical & Domain Knowledge

- Knowledge of major enterprise ecosystems and their licensing models: SAP (incl. S/4HANA), Microsoft (Microsoft 365, Enterprise Agreement, Azure), Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow.

- Experience sourcing and negotiating cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), including consumption-based pricing models and data residency clauses.

- Familiarity with sourcing cybersecurity solutions (e.g. identity management, EDR, SIEM) and the related contractual security clauses.

- Knowledge of compliance requirements in regulated environments (GxP, Computer System Validation - CSV, 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11), relevant to the pharmaceutical sector and to the purchase of systems impacting validated processes).

- Familiarity with sourcing cybersecurity solutions (e.g. identity management, EDR, SIEM) and the related contractual security clauses.

- Knowledge of compliance requirements in regulated environments (GxP, Computer System Validation - CSV, 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11), relevant to the pharmaceutical sector and to the purchase of systems impacting validated processes).
descriptionByLocale.fr:
The IT Category Manager is responsible for the end-to-end procurement strategy and operational management of all Information Technology spend at IBSA, including software, hardware and IT consultancy services.

A core principle of this role is the adoption of a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) approach to all sourcing decisions, prioritising long-term value and holistic risk management

The Category Manager must be able to articulate and share this perspective to internal stakeholders and ensure it is embedded in all category strategies and supplier evaluations.

The position acts as the strategic interface between the Procurement function and the Enterprise Technology & Transformation (ET&T) function, ensuring that IT sourcing decisions deliver value for money, minimise risk, and align with IBSA's digital transformation agenda. Category strategy is defined in close collaboration with ET&T leadership, ensuring full alignment between technology direction and procurement execution.

Key Responsibilities

Category Strategy

- Develop and implement a comprehensive IT category strategy covering software (licences, SaaS, ERP), hardware (infrastructure, devices, network) and IT consulting and managed services — defined in concert with the Enterprise Technology & Transformation (ET&T) function to ensure full alignment with the technology roadmap.

- Conduct regular market analysis to identify sourcing opportunities, emerging vendors and technology trends relevant to IBSA's business.

- Define and maintain a supplier segmentation model and category roadmap aligned with business priorities.

- Embed a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) methodology in all category decisions, ensuring that short-term price savings are never pursued at the expense of long-term value, service continuity or operational risk.

- Maintain an IT supply risk register, proactively identifying and mitigating concentration risk, vendor dependency, cybersecurity exposure, and contract lock-in.

Sourcing & Contracting

- Lead competitive tender processes (RFI, RFQ, RFP) for IT categories in full compliance with IBSA procurement policy.

- Negotiate contracts, SLAs, pricing structures and commercial terms with IT vendors, ensuring best Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) — with explicit consideration of implementation, integration, maintenance, training and exit costs, not only licence or purchase price.

- Manage contract lifecycle including renewals, amendments and exit strategies.

- Work closely with Legal to ensure contractual protection on data security, IP, liability and GDPR compliance.

Supplier Relationship Management

- Build and maintain strategic relationships with key IT suppliers, conducting regular business reviews and performance evaluations.

- Monitor supplier performance against agreed KPIs and SLAs; escalate issues and drive corrective action plans where necessary.

- Identify and develop alternative sources to reduce supply risk.

Stakeholder Management

- Act as the primary procurement business partner for the ET&T function and other internal stakeholders with IT spend.

- Collaborate with ET&T leadership to understand demand forecasts, project pipelines and technology roadmaps.

Financial, Compliance & Governance Management

- Deliver measurable added value within the IT category on an annual basis.

- Manage category spend transparency, providing accurate and timely reporting on committed and forecast expenditure.

- Support the annual budget process by providing market intelligence and benchmark data to IT stakeholders.

- Ensure all IT procurement activities comply with IBSA internal policies, procedures and applicable regulations.

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Master's degree or equivalent in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or related field

- Minimum 10 years of experience in procurement, with at least 5 years in IT category management in a multinational environment.

- Demonstrated track record of managing complex IT contracts (software licensing, cloud services, hardware, consulting).

- Strong negotiation skills with experience in large-scale vendor negotiations.

- Solid understanding of IT market dynamics, licensing models (perpetual, subscription, SaaS) and managed service structures.

- Experience with P2P platforms and e-procurement tools; familiarity with Jaggaer is a plus.

- Fluent in English and Italian; French or German is an advantage.

Key Competencies

- Strategic thinking: ability to develop category strategies that align with business objectives and deliver long-term value.

- Commercial acumen: strong analytical skills and financial literacy; ability to model TCO across the full asset lifecycle and evaluate complex commercial proposals beyond headline price.

- Risk management: proactive identification and mitigation of supply, contractual, cybersecurity and operational risk in the IT category; ability to balance risk appetite with commercial opportunity.

- Influencing skills: Effective at building relationships and influencing without formal authority across functions and seniority levels.

- Results orientation: proactive, ownership mindset with a track record of delivering against targets in complex environments.

- Integrity & compliance: uncompromising ethical standards; ensures all procurement activity is conducted with full transparency.

Technical & Domain Knowledge

- Knowledge of major enterprise ecosystems and their licensing models: SAP (incl. S/4HANA), Microsoft (Microsoft 365, Enterprise Agreement, Azure), Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow.

- Experience sourcing and negotiating cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), including consumption-based pricing models and data residency clauses.

- Familiarity with sourcing cybersecurity solutions (e.g. identity management, EDR, SIEM) and the related contractual security clauses.

- Knowledge of compliance requirements in regulated environments (GxP, Computer System Validation - CSV, 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11), relevant to the pharmaceutical sector and to the purchase of systems impacting validated processes).

jobs.title: Lead HR Operations Officer
jobs.description:
Il ruolo

La posizione è inserita nel dipartimento HR Operations, all’interno dell’organizzazione Human Resources & Organization del Gruppo IBSA.

Il/la Lead HR Operations Officer avrà la responsabilità di garantire una gestione puntuale, efficiente e conforme dei principali processi di amministrazione del personale, payroll e assicurazioni sociali. In questa posizione opererà con un elevato livello di autonomia e rappresenterà un punto di riferimento per collaboratori, stakeholder interni, autorità ed enti esterni.

Principali responsabilità

- Gestire l’intero ciclo amministrativo del personale, assicurando accuratezza, rispetto delle scadenze e conformità alla normativa vigente.

- Coordinare le pratiche relative a malattia, infortunio, maternità, paternità e altre assenze.

- Coordinare gli adempimenti connessi agli assegni familiari e alle assicurazioni sociali.

- Predisporre e monitorare le richieste e i rinnovi dei permessi di lavoro per i collaboratori.

- Gestire le autorizzazioni relative al lavoro notturno, domenicale e festivo.

- Curare il processo payroll, dalla raccolta e verifica dei dati fino al controllo delle buste paga.

- Garantire la corretta gestione delle riconciliazioni e delle registrazioni contabili relative al personale.

- Collaborare attivamente con gli stakeholder interni, autorità ed enti esterni.

- Fornire consulenza e supporto specialistico ai collaboratori e ai responsabili di funzione su tematiche amministrative, previdenziali e retributive.

- Contribuire all’ottimizzazione, alla digitalizzazione e alla standardizzazione dei processi HR Operations.

- Operare come deputy dell’HR Operations Manager, supportandolo nel coordinamento del team e assumendone le responsabilità operative in caso di assenza.

Profilo richiesto

- Maturità Commerciale (SCC), AFC di Impiegato/a di Commercio o titolo di studio superiore in ambito economico, giuridico, amministrativo o Human Resources.

- Esperienza professionale consolidata di almeno cinque anni in una posizione simile.

- Solida conoscenza della normativa svizzera in materia di diritto del lavoro, assicurazioni sociali, imposte alla fonte e permessi di lavoro.

- Ottima padronanza degli strumenti informatici e dei sistemi HR e payroll.

- Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese; la conoscenza del tedesco e/o francese costituisce un titolo preferenziale.

- Precisione, affidabilità e forte orientamento alla qualità del servizio.

- Capacità di gestire priorità, scadenze e informazioni riservate con discrezione e professionalità.

- Attitudine collaborativa e capacità di interagire efficacemente con interlocutori tecnici, manageriali e istituzionali.

- Approccio proattivo, flessibilità e orientamento al miglioramento continuo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The role

The position is included in the HR Operations department, within the Human Resources & Organization of the IBSA Group.

The Lead HR Operations Officer will be responsible for ensuring timely, efficient and consistent management of the main management processes of staff, payroll and social insurance. In this position it will work with a high level of autonomy and will represent a point of reference for collaborators, internal stakeholders, authorities and external bodies.

Main responsibility

- Manage the entire administrative cycle of staff, ensuring accuracy, compliance with deadlines and compliance with current regulations.

- Coordinate sickness, accident, maternity, paternity and other absences.

- Coordination of family allowances and social insurance.

- Prepare and monitor the demands and renewals of work permits for employees.

- Manage night, Sunday and festive work permits.

- Treat the payroll process, from collecting and checking data to checking the payroll.

- Ensure the correct management of reconciliations and accounting records related to staff.

- To actively collaborate with internal stakeholders, authorities and external bodies.

- Provide specialist advice and support to employees and function managers on administrative, social and pay issues.

- Contribute to optimization, digitization and standardization of HR Operations processes.

- Operating as a deputy of HR Operations Manager, supporting him in the coordination of the team and assuming operational responsibilities in case of absence.

Profile requested

- Commercial Maturity (SCC), Business Employee AFC or higher degree in economic, legal, administrative or Human Resources.

- Consolidated professional experience of at least five years in a similar position.

- Solid knowledge of Swiss labour law legislation, social insurance, source taxes and work permits.

- Excellent mastery of IT tools and HR and payroll systems.

- Good knowledge of English; knowledge of German and/or French is a preferential title.

- Accuracy, reliability and strong orientation to service quality.

- Ability to manage priorities, deadlines and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

- Collaborative attitude and ability to interact effectively with technical, managerial and institutional interlocutors.

- Proactive approach, flexibility and orientation to continuous improvement.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Rolle

Die Position ist in der HR Operations-Abteilung innerhalb der Human Resources & Organisation der IBSA-Gruppe enthalten.

Der leitende HR Operations Officer ist dafür verantwortlich, eine zeitnahe, effiziente und konsistente Verwaltung der wichtigsten Managementprozesse von Personal, Lohn- und Sozialversicherung sicherzustellen. In dieser Position wird es mit einem hohen Maß an Autonomie arbeiten und einen Bezugspunkt für Mitarbeiter, interne Stakeholder, Behörden und externe Stellen darstellen.

Hauptverantwortung

- Verwalten Sie den gesamten Verwaltungszyklus des Personals und gewährleisten Sie Genauigkeit, Einhaltung der Fristen und Einhaltung der geltenden Vorschriften.

- Koordination von Krankheit, Unfall, Mutterschaft, Vaterschaft und anderen Abwesenheiten.

- Koordinierung der Familienzulagen und der Sozialversicherung.

- Vorbereitung und Überwachung der Anforderungen und Erneuerungen von Arbeitserlaubnissen für Arbeitnehmer.

- Verwalten Sie Nacht, Sonntag und festliche Arbeitserlaubnisse.

- Behandeln Sie den Gehaltsabrechnungsprozess, vom Sammeln und Überprüfen von Daten bis zum Überprüfen der Gehaltsabrechnung.

- Gewährleistung der ordnungsgemäßen Verwaltung der Abgleiche und Buchführungsunterlagen im Zusammenhang mit dem Personal.

- Aktive Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern, Behörden und externen Stellen.

- Bereitstellung von Fachberatung und Unterstützung für Mitarbeiter und Funktionsmanager in administrativen, sozialen und Lohnfragen.

- Beitrag zur Optimierung, Digitalisierung und Standardisierung von HR Operations Prozessen.

- Funktioniert als Stellvertreter des HR Operations Managers, unterstützt ihn bei der Koordination des Teams und übernimmt bei Abwesenheit operative Verantwortung.

Profil angefordert

- Commercial Maturity (SCC), Business Employee AFC oder höhere Abschluss in wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen, administrativen oder Human Resources.

- Konsolidierte Berufserfahrung von mindestens fünf Jahren in einer ähnlichen Position.

- Fundierte Kenntnisse des schweizerischen Arbeitsrechts, der Sozialversicherung, der Quellensteuern und der Arbeitserlaubnis.

- Hervorragende Beherrschung von IT-Tools und HR- und Gehaltsabrechnungssystemen.

- Gute Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch- und/oder Französischkenntnisse sind ein bevorzugter Titel.

- Genauigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und starke Ausrichtung auf Servicequalität.

- Fähigkeit, Prioritäten, Fristen und vertrauliche Informationen mit Diskretion und Professionalität zu verwalten.

- Zusammenarbeit und Fähigkeit, effektiv mit technischen, leitenden und institutionellen Gesprächspartnern zu interagieren.

- Proaktiver Ansatz, Flexibilität und Orientierung auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

L'agent principal des opérations des RH sera chargé d'assurer une gestion rapide, efficiente et uniforme des principaux processus de gestion du personnel, de la paie et de l'assurance sociale. Dans cette position, il travaillera avec un haut niveau d'autonomie et représentera un point de référence pour les collaborateurs, les acteurs internes, les autorités et les organismes externes.

- Gérer l'ensemble du cycle administratif du personnel, en veillant à l'exactitude, au respect des délais et au respect des règlements en vigueur.

- Coordonner la maladie, l'accident, la maternité, la paternité et autres absences.

- Coordination des allocations familiales et de l'assurance sociale.

- Préparer et surveiller les demandes et les renouvellements de permis de travail pour les employés.

- Gérer la nuit, le dimanche et les permis de travail festifs.

- Traiter le processus de paye, de la collecte et de la vérification des données à la vérification de la paie.

- Assurer la bonne gestion des rapprochements et des documents comptables liés au personnel.

- Collaborer activement avec les intervenants internes, les autorités et les organismes externes.

- Fournir des conseils et un soutien spécialisés aux employés et aux gestionnaires de fonctions sur les questions administratives, sociales et salariales.

- Contribuer à l'optimisation, à la numérisation et à la normalisation des processus des opérations des RH.

- Fonctionnant comme adjoint du gestionnaire des opérations des RH, l'aidant dans la coordination de l'équipe et assumant des responsabilités opérationnelles en cas d'absence.

Profil demandé

- Échéance commerciale (CSC), employé d'entreprise AFC ou diplôme supérieur en ressources économiques, juridiques, administratives ou humaines.
